question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**ordered**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is describing what exactly happened at a point of time in the past.
 
• **Now, blank 3 will contain a word that will imply how the kind asked the councilor to show him the way.**
 
• **Among the given options, the verb "ordered" is the correct form to fill in the blank in this sentence.**
 
 
• "Ordered" is the past tense of "order", meaning to give a command or instruction.(आदेश दिया)
 
 
• ​Example: The boss ordered him to finish the task.
 
 
 
 
 
• The other options, "controlled", "controls", and "orders", do not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• - "Controlled" and "controls" are forms of the verb "control", meaning to regulate or manage something.(नियंत्रित)
 
• - "Orders" is the present tense of "order", meaning to give a command or instruction.(आदेश)
